title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – Schusswaffe, Geld und Drogen beschlagnahmt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed ten search warrants across Berlin against five suspects accused of trafficking cocaine via "cocaine taxis". A real pistol, about 50 kg of cannabis, 500 g of cocaine and around 100,000 euros in cash were seized, and one 24-year-old suspect was remanded in custody.
